fields.name: Giant Rat
fields.tell: bares its yellow teeth and crouches to spring

fields.name: Goblin
fields.tell: shrieks and lifts its rusty cleaver over its head

fields.name: Skeleton
fields.tell: rattles back, raising its sword in both bony hands

fields.name: Cave Crab
fields.tell: opens its huge claw wide, aiming for your leg

fields.name: Thorn Sprite
fields.tell: bristles all over, every thorn pointed at you

fields.name: Hobgoblin
fields.tell: plants its feet and hauls back a spiked club

fields.name: Ghoul
fields.tell: unhinges its jaw, gathering itself to lunge

fields.name: Dire Wolf
fields.tell: lowers its head and gathers itself for a leap

fields.name: Bog Lurker
fields.tell: sinks low, ripples racing toward you through the water

fields.name: Vine Horror
fields.tell: coils every vine back like a drawn bowstring

fields.name: Orc
fields.tell: roars and swings a great axe up over its shoulder

fields.name: Troll
fields.tell: rips a slab of stone out of the wall and hoists it overhead

fields.name: Wight
fields.tell: draws the warmth from the room into one freezing claw

fields.name: Ghost
fields.tell: wails, and the air turns to grave-cold needles

fields.name: The Drowned Abbot
fields.tell: raises a censer that drips black water, chanting backwards

fields.name: The Goblin King
fields.tell: stands on his throne and hefts a sceptre made from a frying pan

fields.name: The Thornmother
fields.tell: draws every root in the room taut, ready to lash

fields.name: Palp Guard
fields.tell: Slowly undulates in a circle
fields.desc: An unnerving beast that somehow seems both human and alien.

fields.name: Reliquary Hermit
fields.tell: ducks down inside its skull, every claw drawn back to spring
fields.desc: A hermit crab that outgrew its shell and moved into a bishop. It is very protective of the new place.

fields.name: Tallow Saint
fields.tell: lifts its head as its wick flares white-hot
fields.desc: A pilgrim who prayed by candlelight so long he became the candle. He still mumbles the vespers, and he does not like to be interrupted.

fields.name: Goblin Stewmancer
fields.tell: bangs its ladle on its pot-helm and starts chanting into the brew
fields.desc: Goblin shamans don't study magic, they cook it. The pot on its head is the last batch that worked.

fields.name: Lantern Moth
fields.tell: folds its wings and dives straight at your light
fields.desc: A moth the size of a shield, drawn to your torch the way you were drawn to this dungeon. One of you is going to regret it.

fields.name: Mossback Warden
fields.tell: plants its feet, tearing roots out of the floor, and raises both fists
fields.desc: A temple guardian that stood still so long the forest mistook it for furniture. Something has just reminded it of its orders.

fields.name: Shriekroot
fields.tell: sucks in one enormous breath, swelling to twice its size
fields.desc: A turnip with opinions and the lungs to back them up. Pull it up and it will tell you exactly how it feels about that.

fields.name: Living Armor
fields.tell: raises its sword high, and something wet squelches inside the helmet
fields.desc: Not haunted. Infested. A colony of crypt snails moved into an old knight's armor and learned to walk it around. Reportedly delicious with garlic butter.

fields.name: Walking Toadstool
fields.tell: shakes its cap, and a cloud of red spores rolls toward you
fields.desc: A toadstool that got tired of waiting for things to die near it and went looking. It smells wonderful. Do not eat the spotted ones. Probably.

fields.name: Fishman
fields.tell: puffs out its gills and lowers its trident for a lunge
fields.desc: Half fish, half man, entirely damp. It guards the flooded halls with a trident it found down here and a grudge it brought with it.

fields.name: Gelatinous Cube
fields.tell: quivers, and everything floating inside it drifts toward you
fields.desc: The dungeon's janitor. It eats whatever is left lying around and keeps the shiny bits, which is why most adventurers meet it face-first, reaching for a coin.

fields.name: Rat King
fields.tell: turns every one of its heads toward you at once, screeching
fields.desc: Six rats whose tails knotted together in the dark. They can't agree on which way to go, but they all agree about you.

fields.name: Granny Gristle
fields.tell: drops her pack with a terrible clang and pulls out the frying pan
fields.desc: A kobold pawnbroker who carries her whole shop on her back, rubber chicken included. She buys anything, sells everything, and has outlived three dungeons and every adventurer who tried to haggle. Steal from her and find out why.

fields.name: Granny Kamultruk
fields.tell: cups a claw around her candle and screeches, "NO TAKE CANDLE!"
fields.desc: Granny Gristle's cousin from the deep tunnels. She'll sell you anything except the candle. No take candle!

fields.name: Lucky Lenny
fields.tell: WOAH WOAH WOAH WOAH
fields.desc: Lennys cousin is a leprechaun but ironically unlucky.  He got his tooth knocked out by a goblin pan, now he has a gold crown in it's place.

fields.name: Baby Joey
fields.tell: Gimme dat!!
fields.desc: I don't think Joey is a baby but if you get close enough you might get robbed...

fields.name: King Mouse
fields.tell: squeeeeeeeEEAKKK!!!
fields.desc: VEERY BIG MOUSE!!! BEWARE THE CLAWS! (boss)

fields.name: Swoogy The Gooey
fields.tell: Swoogy charges up his flaps...
fields.desc:
A strong whiff hits your nose... A manchild's scent

He hides in secret rooms and loves a guessing game: get the number on his die right and his prized underwear is yours. Get it wrong and he gets VERY cranky.

fields.name: Swamp Bottoms
fields.tell: Somethings Comin'!!!!
fields.desc: Shorts found in the jungle and swamps.  If you get to close to his swamp you might get tangled in his jungle vines...

fields.name: Serpentis
fields.tell: SSSSSSSSSSSSSsssssss
fields.desc: Serpentis was around in about the first billionth year of the cosmos and fought in the war of the third billionth year. It has not forgotten. It is still a bit cranky about it.

fields.name: Venom Toad
fields.tell: draws a deep, gurgling breath. You can smell the poison!
fields.desc: A fat purple toad the size of a footstool, its back studded with glowing green warts. Bubbles of poison seep from its skin and pop with a hiss. It squats and stares with huge yellow eyes, then spits a gob of stinging slime.

fields.name: Cinder Imp
fields.tell: throws back its head and cackles, its belly flaring white-hot as its wings sweep high overhead.
fields.desc: A knee-high red imp with stubby horns, a toothy grin and leathery purple wings that never stop flapping. An ember glows in its belly, and it zips about the room, flinging sparks and giggling at every miss. It loves a good trick, and it can be bribed with shiny things. Flying enemies need to be hit by something thrown to be able to hit them. Status flying and status downed

fields.name: Hymn Toad
fields.tell: draws a deep, gurgling breath
fields.desc: A toad the size of a pew, who sings hymns to the drowned.

fields.name: Grinning Gasbag
fields.tell: puffs up like an angry balloon, its grin crackling with blue sparks.
fields.desc: A floating red ball of grumpiness with one huge green eye, two stubby horns and a grin full of teeth. It drifts through the halls spitting sizzling fireballs and cackling at its own jokes, which are not funny. It flies, so something thrown reaches it best, and one good poke with something sharp makes it hiss like a popped balloon.

fields.name: Jar Warrior
fields.tell: plants its stubby legs, booms \"Hrrrmmm!\" and leaps high to belly-flop with its whole jar.
fields.desc: A warrior who is also a great clay jar, with a rope round its neck, stubby fists and two little eyes glinting from the dark inside its mouth. It speaks in a big cheerful voice about honor and the joy of a good scrap, and it sloshes when it walks. It loves a fair duel and hates being rude, so a polite word can talk it down. Whatever is inside, it would rather you didn't ask.

fields.name: Treasure Mimic
fields.tell: flings its lid wide open, tongue flapping, and rattles every coin in its belly.
fields.desc: A treasure chest that is not a treasure chest. Under the lid are rows of white teeth, two greedy yellow eyes and a long slobbery tongue, and it scuttles sideways on little crab legs. It snaps at anyone who reaches for the lock. Tie its lid shut with a rope or toss it a snack and it forgets all about you. Dungeon cooks say it tastes just like lobster.

fields.name: Rusty Sword
fields.desc: More rust than sword. It has opinions about tetanus.

fields.name: Hand Axe
fields.desc: A woodcutter's axe that took up a more exciting career.

fields.name: War Pick
fields.desc: Built for opening armor the way a can opener opens cans.

fields.name: Silvered Blade
fields.desc: Silver-chased steel. The undead hate it, which says a lot about the undead.

fields.name: Leather Jerkin
fields.desc: Smells like a cow that had a hard life.

fields.name: Chain Shirt
fields.desc: Jingles when you sneak. You will not be sneaking.

fields.name: Scale Hauberk
fields.desc: Overlapping scales from something you hope is extinct.

fields.name: Healing Potion
fields.desc: Red, fizzy, tastes like pennies. Restores 8 HP.

fields.name: Greater Healing Potion
fields.desc: The good stuff. Restores 16 HP.

fields.name: Stale Bread
fields.desc: Technically food. Technically a weapon. Restores 3 HP.

fields.name: Wheel of Cheese
fields.desc: A whole wheel. Beasts find it irresistible. Restores 6 HP.

fields.name: Smoke Bomb
fields.desc: Throw it, then leave dramatically. Guaranteed escape.

fields.name: Pure
fields.desc: A little blue bottle labelled PURE in very serious letters. Cures poison, and what stays in your blood stops the next poisoning taking hold. Tastes like licking a battery.

fields.name: Flask of Lamp Oil
fields.desc: Flammable, throwable, regrettable. Plants and trolls fear fire.

fields.name: Vial of Holy Water
fields.desc: Blessed by a priest who was mostly sober. The undead hate it.

fields.name: Bag of Marbles
fields.desc: Hundreds of tiny ankle-betrayers.

fields.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
fields.desc: Less lucky for the rabbit. Raises your Fate limit by 1 while carried.

fields.name: Barnacled Reliquary Key
fields.desc: Opens the Abbot's sanctum. Crusted with things that used to be alive.

fields.name: Shed Snakeskin
fields.desc: An old snakeskin, HUGE, smelly, and stained purple all over. Worn as a cloak it's thinner than good armor, but poison can't take hold of you: not a bite, not a river, not a vent's gas.

fields.name: Watcher's Orb
fields.desc: An orb from an old bird-headed statue's hands, as if it had been waiting just for you. It hums near Serpentis's lair, and opens it.

fields.name: Greasy Throne-Room Key
fields.desc: Opens the Goblin King's throne cave. Sticky in a way you'd rather not investigate.

fields.name: Living Seed-Key
fields.desc: Opens the Heartwood. It occasionally sprouts.

fields.name: Superior Healing Potion
fields.desc: Liquid sunrise in a heart-shaped flask. Glows a little. Hums a little. Restores 24 HP.

fields.name: A Ring, Probably Important
fields.desc: A plain gold ring that gets heavier every floor you descend. It keeps suggesting you put it on. It makes some very good points. Do not listen to it.

fields.name: Snitch
fields.desc: An elven letter-opener that glows blue whenever goblins are near. In the Goblin Warren it never, ever stops glowing.

fields.name: Moonsilver Vest
fields.desc: Light as a feather, harder than dragon scale, and worth more than everything else in this dungeon combined. Wear it under your shirt and tell no one.

fields.name: Second Breakfast
fields.desc: You had breakfast, yes. This is the second one, which everyone knows is the important one. Restores 18 HP.

fields.name: The Compensator
fields.desc: A sword so large it is mostly a door. You will need spiky hair and a tragic past to swing it properly.

fields.name: Sword Still in the Stone
fields.desc: You couldn't pull it out, so you brought the rock. It hits like a king and weighs like a quarry.

fields.name: Adamant Stewpot
fields.desc: A cookpot forged from a metal far too precious to cook in, so naturally its last owner cooked in it every night. Wear it, cook in it, hit things with it. A good pot is all three.

fields.name: Basilisk Omelette
fields.desc: Half chicken, half serpent, entirely breakfast. Cooked by someone who looked at a basilisk and thought about dinner. Restores 16 HP.

fields.name: Hallowed Hand Grenade
fields.desc: Pull the pin, count to three, throw. The number is three. The instructions are very, very firm about this.

fields.name: Rubber Chicken
fields.desc: Squeaks on impact. It does almost no damage, but nothing down here has ever seen one before, and that has to count for something.

fields.name: Suspicious Sweetroll
fields.desc: Someone is going to try to steal this. Someone always tries to steal this. Restores 8 HP.

fields.name: 64GB DDR5 RAM Kit
fields.desc: Two sticks of the rarest treasure of any age. Worth more than this dungeon, the town above it, and possibly your soul. It does nothing down here, but the RGB does light up a room.

fields.name: Almanac of Future Scores
fields.desc: Fifty years of sports results that haven't happened yet. Worth a fortune if you can find a bookie, a sport, and a way home. Until then it's just a very smug book.

fields.name: Laser Pointer
fields.desc: Click it and a tiny red dot appears. Every beast in the room will chase it, and so will most goblins. Never point it at eyes, even the ones on stalks.

fields.name: Rubber Duck
fields.desc: Explain your problem to it out loud and the answer usually comes to you. It floats, it squeaks, and it has quietly solved half the puzzles in this dungeon.

fields.name: Ten-Foot Pole
fields.desc: For poking anything you wouldn't touch with your hands: chests, puddles, suspiciously quiet floors. No adventurer has ever regretted bringing one.

fields.name: Bubble Wrap
fields.desc: Pop one bubble and every head in the room turns. Pop the whole sheet and something down here will hold a grudge.

fields.name: Glow Stick
fields.desc: Snap it, shake it, and toss it down a hole to see how deep the hole goes. Glows for one night. Smells faintly of a party you weren't invited to.

fields.name: Mysterious Floppy Disk
fields.desc: Labelled DUNGEON_MAP_FINAL_v2(1). There is no way to read it down here, but it flies surprisingly well if you throw it.

fields.name: Torch
fields.desc: A pitch-soaked torch. Dark corners stop being so dark, and secrets stop being so secret.

fields.name: Weighted Dice
fields.desc: A pair of dice that always know which way is down. Don't let anyone see you use them.

fields.name: Bomb
fields.desc: A round black bomb with a short fuse. Opens a wall with something behind it, or ruins a monster's day.

fields.name: Small Key
fields.desc: A small iron key. It opens most chests without asking questions.

fields.name: Mama's Shillelagh
fields.desc: A knurled blackthorn stick, polished smooth where a hand gripped it through a thousand tellings. Whoever carries it tells a better story: +1 wit in conversation. Nobody down here knows who Mama was, but every one of them has heard of her.

fields.name: Davy J. Skull
fields.desc: R.I.P Davy Jones.  Too scary for all the "kids" in here.

fields.name: Lenny's Good Tooth
fields.desc: Lenny's good tooth...... "*POP*, don't need this anymore" - Lucky Lenny (+1 luck)

fields.name: Lenny's Bad Tooth
fields.desc: Lenny's Bad Tooth.."OOOH This stinks" -The Last Adventurer..... (-1 wit, +1 might)

fields.name: Unusual Butter
fields.desc: This is no ordinary butter, you could even say its "exotic". +1 to all stats and +5 hp

fields.name: Jar o' Light
fields.desc: A glass jar packed with rare, glowing cave insects.  Eating it makes you glow, causing all nearby enemies to flee in terror.

fields.name: Hard Hat
fields.desc: Some ol' coal miners hat....

fields.name: Pickle
fields.desc: If it looks like a pickle and tickles like a pickle, it's probably a cucumber

fields.name: Pizza Rat
fields.desc: PIZZA!!!... wait I have to eat both?  Long way down the evolution line of King Mouses servants...(+8 for pizza -2 for rat)

fields.name: King Mouse's Vest
fields.desc: Defeated King Mouse's clothing. YOU ARE INEVITABLE!!!

fields.name: Swoogy's Diaper
fields.desc:
Fully loaded.

-2 Health Per Floor when held
-2 damage per from enemy hits - this thing reeks and they don't want to be that close to you.

fields.name: Bottle o' Baby
fields.desc: A peculiar little fellow in a bottle, perhaps the heir to a certain someone. Uncork him and he wails loud enough to stop a monster mid-swing.

fields.name: Lava Rubies
fields.desc: Mmmmm, lava rubies. Not for eating: hurl them and the lava inside completely ANNIHILATES whatever they hit.

fields.name: Magical Cards
fields.desc: Ancient cards from 620 AD, an old blacksmith's new invention for bending chance itself. While you carry them you can hold one more Fate token, and they deal you one when you pick them up.

fields.name: Bloodbath
fields.desc: Serpentis's old sword, from way back before Zeus, possessed by Typhon in the apocalyptic war of the third billionth year. It still remembers obliterating everything it touched.

fields.name: Bomb Fairy
fields.desc: A sassy fairy who loves chaos. Find a bomb? Now it's two bombs!

fields.name: Firebird Plume
fields.desc: A warm golden-red feather that smells faintly of campfire and glows like a sunset. In old stories it brings fallen heroes back to their feet. Tickling a monster with it is not recommended, but we don't judge. Saves you from a death once if in your pack.

fields.name: The Butcher's Cleaver
fields.desc: A huge, chipped meat cleaver, spotted with rust and heavy enough to split a door. Its last owner wore a stained apron and greeted every visitor by sizing them up for supper. It still hums a little whenever someone opens a cellar door.

fields.name: Wall Chicken
fields.desc: A whole roast chicken, piping hot, found inside a dungeon wall. Nobody knows who keeps putting them there, or how they stay so crispy. Smash the wall, eat the chicken, feel much better. Don't think about it too hard.
